subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the third day of open sky after emerging from the Underdark.
source_quote: The third day of open sky and I still hadn't stopped scanning.

subject: travel to Mithral Hall
fact: Eldeth must go to Mithral Hall to inform the dwarves of what is happening in the Underdark.
source_quote: I must go to Mithral Hall. I must inform the dwarves of what is going on in the Underdark.

subject: chasme count
fact: Twelve simultaneous strikes from an opponent with no readable stance, no telegraphed motion, and a body that is essentially a liquid — that was actually a serious problem for anyone trying to defend against it.
source_quote: It's easy to do, like, twelve hits in a round when you have twelve arms.

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits as the origin point of Eldeth’s obligations, a place where the pull toward the surface began.
source_quote: That had been pulling at her since Velkynvelve.

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: travel to Candlekeep
fact: Head west and you'll hit Candlekeep — simple as that, the way she says most things that aren't simple at all.
source_quote: Head west and you'll hit Candlekeep. Simple as that, the way she says most things that aren't simple at all.

subject: Candlekeep Library
fact: Candlekeep seems like the kind of place someone like [Spiderbait] could find a job doing something innocuous.
source_quote: This Candlekeep place seems like the kind of place someone like me could find a job doing something innocuous.

subject: Glabbagool's awakening
fact: Glabbagool just looked up — and there was something in the stillness of him that wasn't his usual stillness. He wasn't being a floor. He was witnessing.
source_quote: Glabbagool — Glabbagool just looked up. ... He wasn't being a floor. He was witnessing.

subject: drow outpost
fact: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky — a reference to the elevation and isolation of their former position.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: Dawnbringer's agency
fact: Weapons don't have agency. Except mine.
source_quote: Weapons don't have agency. Except mine.

subject: Zalthir's vigil
fact: The trees north of us were wrong — the wrongness was in the negative space: no birds, no wind-shift in undergrowth. Something was in there, patient and pacing.
source_quote: The trees north of us were wrong. ... Something was in there, and whatever it was had been in there long enough to develop the habit of staying still.

subject: pledge to the clan
fact: After I have spoken and explained to the lords of Gauntlgrym and Mithral Hall the dangers of the Underdark, I am certain they will want to speak to you, and I will make it a statement of purpose that you shall be embraced by our clan.
source_quote: After I have spoken and explained to the lords of Gauntlgrym and Mithral Hall the dangers of the Underdark, I am certain they will want to speak to you, and I will make it a statement of purpose that you shall be embraced by our clan.

subject: Dawnbringer's warmth
fact: Dawnbringer radiated warmth the way a hearth does — not directed at anything in particular, just present.
source_quote: Dawnbringer, at least, had no such ambivalence. ... It radiated warmth the way a hearth does.

subject: Grygum's mistaken deer
fact: You conclude that what is following you is a deer — a misread environmental cue that the group collectively overruled.
source_quote: You conclude, that what is following you is a deer.

subject: Gauntlgrym
fact: Gauntlgrym is the ancient dwarven stronghold where Eldeth must speak to the lords after Mithral Hall.
source_quote: After I have spoken and explained to the lords of Gauntlgrym and Mithral Hall the dangers of the Underdark...

subject: Zalthir's training curriculum
fact: The run, run, slap, slap, slap that Glabbagool apparently had very strong feelings about — it would require some foundational work first.
source_quote: the run, run, slap, slap, slap that Glabbagool apparently had very strong feelings about

subject: Eldeth's promise
fact: I swear — the sworn oath that sealed Thorin’s inclusion in the dwarven clan.
source_quote: I swear.

subject: Underdark
fact: Months underground — the habits don't switch off just because the ceiling lifts.
source_quote: Months underground — the habits don't switch off just because the ceiling lifts.

subject: Zalthir's tactical realization
fact: The thing in the trees is not a deer — a silent, shared acknowledgment among the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: The three of us looked at each other in the way that the Ember Vanguard has developed as a private language: no words, just a shared acknowledgment that the thing in the trees is not a deer.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: The dusk settled around us. North of the road, something that was not a deer held its position and waited.

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: I did not rule it out.

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: Glabbagool, doing his best. His impression of a bird was everything you'd expect from a creature that has never encountered a bird, never encountered the concept of sound being produced intentionally for communication purposes, and was working from approximately zero reference points.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: Someone speculated it might be Jimjar, coming to drag us back underground.

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Daz was already climbing down from the tree.

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: Grygum held out the prayer beads. He didn't say anything particularly ominous. He just handed them to her and told her to put them on.

subject: interrogation of the drow spy
fact: The drow spy was grappled, stunned, and interrogated by the party after being tracked on the surface.
source_quote: Zalthir had already ended the question of whether there would be a fight. There would not. The spy — drow, slight, female, exactly as advertised — was grappled and stunned, held in place with the kind of efficient finality that Zalthir brings to everything he considers a problem worth solving immediately.

subject: drow house affiliation
fact: The drow spy is of House T'sarran, ruled by a matron mother with two centuries of tenure.
source_quote: I am of House T'sarran. My matron will know one of hers fell out here, and that is enough.

subject: prayer beads value
fact: The prayer beads given to the drow spy are holy symbols of an alien faith, used to break her professional composure.
source_quote: Grygum held out the prayer beads. He didn't say anything particularly ominous. He just handed them to her and told her to put them on.

subject: drow surveillance motive
fact: The drow spy was not tracking the party for harm, but as bait to identify the one who paid to protect the drow protagonist.
source_quote: My matron believes that the one who paid — " and here she pointed at me, with the resigned precision of someone who has run out of misdirection — "for him, will reveal themselves once he reaches the surface. We are looking for that person, not for you.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: daz count
fact: Daz is the target of theoretical murder planning while a restrained enemy watches the party debate it.
source_quote: I am categorically on record as being the only person in this party who treats information as a finite and valuable resource, and yet here I was, the subject of active theoretical murder planning while a restrained enemy watched us debate it.

subject: Candlekeep access
fact: Five books are required to secure FaceTime with the avowed at Candlekeep.
source_quote: The rules say that you must provide one book per group. But if you have come to ask more than one question and wish to intersect with many of the avowed — providing more books will get you more FaceTime.

subject: prayer beads power
fact: The prayer beads are at full power despite being shrunken, and may be more deadly.
source_quote: Those prayer beads are at full power, even though they're shrunken, right? ... Yes — in fact, I believe they may be more deadly.

subject: bag of holding conditions
fact: The drow spy is contained in a bag of holding with holes poked for air, shielded from sunlight, and monitored by Glabbagool.
source_quote: We can put her in the bag of holding with Glabbagool, and he can just hold onto her. ... Poke holes. Let her breathe. Like a hamster.

subject: Glabbagool's surveillance
fact: Glabbagool maintains unblinking, steady surveillance of the miniaturized drow spy with one eye.
source_quote: He had been assigned a job. He was doing the job. The care in it — the steadiness of that unblinking attention — was the most earnest thing I'd seen in weeks.

subject: drow spy's captivity
fact: The drow spy is miniaturized, confined, surveilled, and shielded from sunlight as an act of mercy.
source_quote: She was small, surveilled by an ooze, breathing through holes we'd poked in the bag, and being shielded from sunlight as a kindness.

subject: velkynvelve prisoner journal
fact: The Velkynvelve Prisoner Journal is considered a masterpiece of drow prison literature and is held in high reverence by the First Reader.
source_quote: This journal of the prisoners is a masterpiece of interesting value. I can't wait to study it carefully. It will go great with my other editions in drow prison journals.

subject: glabbagool's question
fact: Glabbagool is granted one question at Candlekeep, despite his confusion over knowledge limits.
source_quote: We give all five books. ... Thorin proposed giving Glabbagool his own question, which I thought was extremely fair.

subject: glabbagool's eyes
fact: Glabbagool produces proliferating googly eyes as affectations to appear more friendly, while retaining true perception.
source_quote: I can actually see different ways. This is how ooze work. But I discovered that if you have these cute eyes, people take you more friendly. And then, to demonstrate his actual authority, he started producing eyes. Many eyes. Proliferating eyes.

subject: Stroud's Gambit
fact: Stroud's Gambit is the legendary, definitive move that overturned four hundred years of analysis by Protanther and shifted the theological landscape of Bahamut half-orc conversions.
source_quote: Stroud's Gambit

subject: Bahamut half-orc conversion research
fact: Vareth's previously obscure field of Bahamut half-orc conversions has become a flood of academic interest, funded and conference-driven, after the arrival of a living half-orc cleric of Bahamut.
source_quote: the arrival of a cleric of Bahamut

subject: Malfire citation
fact: Malfire's citation in Volume 3 has become an ambient, unchallenged reference point in the party's shared history, invoked as authoritative despite lack of laughter.
source_quote: As Malfire said in Volume 3

subject: prayer book
fact: The prayer book is among the accumulated notes and theological documents that form the evidentiary base for understanding the broader theological landscape of the Underdark.
source_quote: the prayer book

subject: theological documents
fact: The theological documents are part of the accumulated evidence of months in the Underdark, used to interrogate Bahamut's intentions and the nature of conversion.
source_quote: the theological documents

subject: accumulated evidence
fact: The accumulated evidence of months in the Underdark forms the foundation for the narrator's ongoing inquiry into theological anomalies and the unexpected efficacy of ignorance.
source_quote: the accumulated evidence of months in the Underdark
